name: ESM XApp Main
brief: Regression test: a var Rec mutation in a CROSS-APP OnAfterValidateEvent subscriber must propagate to the validated record.
description: Main app: subscribes (from this app) to the OnAfterValidateEvent of a field on a table defined in the sibling 'ESM XApp Table' app, mutates the record by reference, and asserts the change is visible on the validated record. Mirrors an ISV subscribing to a BaseApp table field validate.
